criteria.text: rhythm_start_coordinator_goal on a captured goal dispatches exactly one workflow-orchestrator child whose cwd is a NEW worktree of the repo, permission mode bypassPermissions.
A bypass run outside an isolated worktree is refused before any child exists.
The repo is taken only from the user-authored goal text and must be exactly one git work tree; otherwise the start is held and no child is created.
startCodingWorkflow passes the goal's repo to the dispatch, replays without a second child, and a goal naming no repo returns repo_required without dispatching.
Two goals -> two children running at once in separate worktrees/branches.
criteria.reason: Concurrency against the real engine is shown in the live sandbox demo; no per-parent cap exists in code (c3 covers two running rows).

criteria.text: The run list returns one row per dispatched goal with objective, worktree, live branch, status running|needs_you|finished|failed|unknown, reported flag, and usage summed over the run's session tree.
Coordinator card shows the run list and polls while any run is running/needs_you.
